title: EPA Completed Water Reuse Action 5.2: Monitoring Practices — Phase 65 Water review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Water reporting pack. EPA lists completed Action 5.2 on identifying water-quality monitoring practices for reuse applications, creating a measurement rail for later operating comparisons.
key_findings: The action addresses monitoring practices for reuse applications.
EPA separates completed action summaries from the broader progress update.
why_it_matters: Which records distinguish plans and monitoring guidance from accepted assets, measured flows, service reliability, allocation, and compatible reuse outcomes? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. This record advances grid, water, storage, and minerals infrastructure performance from upstream activity into a named operating, measurement, or explicit comparison-boundary record.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of eight Phase 55Z records for grid, water, storage, and minerals infrastructure performance.

evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
